capabilities: Display an alternate name under the file's inline title
Read the alternate name from a configurable note property
Configure which property is used via plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a renaming tool; it only displays an extra name from a property and does not change file or note titles.
extras: Setup requires enabling 'Show inline title' in Obsidian's appearance settings and typing --- to open the Properties panel; a demo screenshot is referenced in the README.
intentEvidence: This plugin provide another name under the inline title of your file.
motivation: The author is a non-native English speaker who writes concept notes in Chinese and wants the English name shown under the Chinese title without looking messy.
problem: Obsidian's inline title shows only the filename, so bilingual users can't neatly display a second-language name under it without cluttering the title.
summary: Title display plugin that shows an alternate name under the file's inline title, taken from a note property.
